title: Heavenly Beauty From Within.

The two of us reserved this 90 minute tour several weeks ahead of our Catholic Pilgrimage because Glimmer Tours did NOT include an inside guided tour.  We met Jose at the Julia Tour office conveniently located across the street from the Basilica where we were also given our “Whisper” listening radios. author: Jody_B

title: Great location to see Sagrada Família!
text: The Julia Tour Office is across the street on the corner from Sagrada Família. Easy access by taxi. Bathroom inside office. Our guide was excellent. When our walking tour finished (through cooled museum and gift shop) it’s easy to find the taxi line to return to your hotel or next destination. This was great for us 8 older travelers.
author: M4498MGjanett

title: An enchanting visit
text: The visit corresponds to the description on the site. The office where you meet the guide is very close to the Sagrada Familia and the guide was punctual and professional. We enjoyed about an hour and 15 minutes of an overview of both Gaudí's life and the symbols hidden in every corner of the Sagrada Familia. At the end of the guided tour, you can still continue to visit the interior of the church at no extra charge. title: Jose was Amazing!

title: Missed Opportunity
text: Having toured the basilica 2 other times we were looking forward to this visit---BUT we had arrived late the night before from a transoceanic flight and unfortunately slept in the morning of the tour!!
author: John_H

title: Great way to tour La Segrada Familia
text: This tour allowed us to “skip the line” with a guide. Sarah F. who fully explained and guided us through security, into the church and provided us with a wonderful overview of the history on through the current day construction. She was personable, professional and answered questions. After the official tour concluded, she explained how to get a view of a tower, which is at your own pace. You are also able to spend as much time as you want on the grounds and in the church. Definitely recommend this tour if you want both a guide and chance to explore in your own.
author: Tour49168111521

title: 20.04.26 Sagrada Familia
text: Our guided tour of the Sagrada Família was absolutely worth every penny. Irina S. was an exceptional guide — knowledgeable, passionate, and full of fascinating stories about Gaudí’s vision and the basilica’s incredible history. Thanks to her, we didn’t just see the building, we truly understood it.
author: marijat590
